TextWidget.Text: No faction has formed. No cause is pulling hard enough on any clan to organise it.
A bloc votes as one: its members back whatever its leader wants. A clan at loyalty 70 or above ignores its bloc and votes with the crown.
OFFICES - CHOOSE A SEAT, THEN A HOUSE
Nothing is held against the crown by this clan.
A house changes sides once in a war, and takes its fiefs with it. The price is paid from the leader's own purse to the house's head.
